toegepas.blok: Hoe jy na 'n dier se prent kyk
toegepas.voor: Hoe jy na 'n dier se prent kyk
toegepas.na: Hoe jy na 'n prent van 'n dier kyk
toegepas.rede_vinder: 'n Dier se prent' reads as a picture belonging to the animal; 'n prent van 'n dier' is the natural form and matches the lesson's other headings.
toegepas.fout: 'n dier se prent' can read as a picture the animal owns, and it breaks the pattern of the lesson's two other headings, which say 'n prent van 'n dier'.
toegepas.rede_keurder: The proposal is the natural Afrikaans form and removes the possessive misreading. It names the same thing, touches no protected wording and adds nothing.

laat_vaar_vorige.blok: Tekstuur: vel, vag, vere en skubbe
laat_vaar_vorige.rede_vinder: 'Voel glad' is the natural collocation for touch; 'bly glad' reads oddly (reviewer: drop if the 'stays smooth' nuance is wanted).
laat_vaar_vorige.rede_keurder: 'bly glad' carries the point that the picture stays smooth despite showing a bumpy nose; 'voel glad' loses that contrast and the original reads fine.

laat_vaar_vorige.blok: Hoe jy na 'n dier se prent kyk
laat_vaar_vorige.rede_vinder: The other steps are linked by eers, dan and laastens; this one stands unlinked, and 'ook' keeps the sequence flowing.
laat_vaar_vorige.rede_keurder: A list of plain imperatives already reads well without a linking word; adding 'ook' is a lateral move.

laat_vaar_vorige.blok: Hoe jy na 'n dier se prent kyk
laat_vaar_vorige.voor: Kyk net so na jou eie prent
laat_vaar_vorige.na: Kyk op dieselfde manier na jou eie prent
laat_vaar_vorige.rede_vinder: 'Net so' can read as 'just like that'; 'op dieselfde manier' says clearly that the same steps are meant.
laat_vaar_vorige.rede_keurder: 'net so' is natural Afrikaans for 'in the same way', and the proposal is a lateral move that also repeats 'dieselfde' with the next sentence.
